reply.text:
I can't give you a dose for BPC-157 or any other peptide, and that holds for any supplement or drug. It's also not an approved treatment, so a doctor is the right person to talk to about what it does or doesn't do for you. If you're recovering from something specific, that's one for a doctor or physio too.

On the training side, I can help with recovery through sleep, eating enough, and how your sessions are spaced and loaded. Want me to look at your recent training and see where recovery might be getting squeezed?
